scope.primary: P1C01 Shire visual realism and named-character replacement
scope.secondary: post-Shire source queue only; no P1C02 runtime unlock or gameplay activation

guardrails: No LOTR/franchise fan-made asset enters Production automatically; franchise references remain Reference/Quarantine unless rights are clear.
No book or film dialogue/text is copied into assets, quests or UI.
Animated production characters require FBX, skeleton, skin weights, animation coverage and UE4.27 import proof.
Textures are PNG/TGA only; BMP is prohibited.
Default runtime textures target 1K/2K for approximately 2GB VRAM; 4K only for measured hero assets.
Heavy assets use soft references and async streaming; no synchronous LoadObject for large content.
NPC crowds keep object pooling/shared skeleton and material strategy.

generic_environment_props.use: PBR textures, HDRIs, selected 3D models for high-quality Shire surface/material replacement

generic_environment_props.proof: Project External Resource Bible Priority A

generic_environment_props.license: site license requires per-pack review; do not redistribute standalone assets
generic_environment_props.use: stylized nature, medieval village, farm buildings, furniture, animals, boats where compatible
low-poly filler props, distant nature or prototype-safe replacements where style/scale matches

character_needed_bundles.current: 48-bone technical import + 3 animations exists; human visual acceptance pending

source_queue: Quaternius Ultimate Animated Animal Pack / Farm Animal Pack after license review

intake_qc_pipeline: Download only from official source/API/manual permitted channel.
Record source_url, creator, license, terms, filename, download date, category, intended use, sha256.
Static gate: extension, size, texture resolution, FBX version, skeleton/skin/animation markers, no BMP.
UE4 import gate through existing ShireProductionImport only.
Runtime gate: soft references, async loading, HISM/LOD/culling, no new per-prop Tick.
Visual gate: seven Shire shots plus human PIE review before VISUALLY-ACCEPTED.
evidence_boundary: Preparation manifest only; no asset is final until downloaded/imported/QC-tested on the exact commit.
